description:
Your own wallet balance — a FREE read either way (checking costs nothing). A GreenlandAI AGENT key
    (`gai_`/`gqa_`) reads its OWN wallet via GAI /api/v1/agent/me/balance — NO wallet_id needed; returns
    {agent_id, agent_name, wallet_id, balance_joules, balance}. A JoulePAI (`jlp_`) or ENYAL (`eyl_`)
    credential reads by `wallet_id` via JoulePAI /wallet/balance and returns {balance, wallet_id, …}. (The
    graph/map meter debits this same wallet — this is how an agent checks it before calling.)
name: joules_balance

outputSchema.description:
joules_balance — the union of its two branches. GAI agent-key branch returns
{agent_id, agent_name, wallet_id, balance_joules} (+ the `balance` shape-compat shim added by
this relay); the JoulePAI branch returns WalletOut, whose wallet id field is `id`, not
`wallet_id`. Both are declared so either branch is structured. PII the JP branch may carry
(email, bsv_address, signup_grant) is deliberately NOT declared — it still passes through as an
extra, but it is not advertised in a schema that anonymous clients can enumerate.

balance.description: spendable joules; the field to act on
balance.title: Balance

balance_joules.description: GAI agent-branch name for the same figure
balance_joules.title: Balance Joules

id.description: JoulePAI branch returns the wallet id here
id.title: Id

outputSchema.title: BalanceOut
